message: You know that moment when you realize your phone is dying just when you need it the most? I had just finished cooking dinner, and as I turned to check on the smoke alarm, my phone beeped that dreadful low battery warning. It hit me—what if I needed to call for help? That’s when I decided to create a solid escape plan that didn’t rely on tech. Now, my family knows exactly what to do and where to go in case of a fire. Ever had a tech fail at a critical moment? What’s your backup plan?
